# skyhub_lan (Resource)

LAN IP, netmask and DHCP pool (singleton, id `default`). **Changing the LAN IP, netmask or the DHCP on/off flag restarts the hub** and drops all connections; the provider endpoint must then be updated. Destroying only removes the resource from state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "skyhub_lan" "this" {
  ip              = "192.168.50.1"
  netmask         = "255.255.255.0"
  dhcp_enabled    = true
  dhcp_pool_start = "192.168.50.2"
  dhcp_pool_end   = "192.168.50.254"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `dhcp_pool_end` (String) Last address of the DHCP pool.
- `dhcp_pool_start` (String) First address of the DHCP pool.
- `ip` (String) LAN gateway IPv4 address.
- `netmask` (String) LAN netmask.

### Optional

- `dhcp_enabled` (Boolean) Run the DHCP server (default true).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `default`.
- `lease_hours` (Number) Lease time in hours (read-only).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import skyhub_lan.this default
```
